issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Preserve the consolidation baseline: canonical request boundary, bounded selection and streaming, fixed-tile and Metal staging, current application/library ownership, CASA and performance evidence, and the deletion ledger.
acceptance_gates: all inherited #319 parity, boundedness, staging, ownership, and deletion checks remain mandatory
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Delete a legacy helper only when the same merge transfers its capability and makes the old route unreachable.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Recover cube Hogbom nsigma late-floor behavior with the #409/#407 diagnosis, late-block evidence, base 3ad7114a, named CASA parity, and a first-divergence diagnostic.
issue_outcomes.current_owner: legacy cube controller and spectral preparation
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: The old cube controller must be unreachable when the native cube cycle transfers.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Map direction-dependent Mueller terms, native convolution functions, and GPU execution explicitly; distributed execution remains outside the first Resource Authority implementation.
issue_outcomes.current_owner: mixed legacy science, convolution-function, and backend paths
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove only routes whose ownership has transferred; retain distributed execution as an explicit non-goal rather than an implicit fallback.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Cubic interpolation must produce genuine cubic contributions and never alias linear interpolation.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove the old cubic alias or rejection path after the paired sampler transfers.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Cube and cubedata Briggs weighting use one globally weighted preparation contract.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove the old mode-specific weighting path.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Deliver true AW and widefield planning with convolution-function planning, starting from precomputed products; AW must never silently route to W projection.
issue_outcomes.current_owner: legacy request, planner, and operator paths
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove AW aliases and duplicate controls once the native AW route and surfaces transfer.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Multi-MeasurementSet selection includes timerange, uvrange, antenna, scan, observation, and intent while preserving exact selected-row order.
issue_outcomes.current_owner: legacy frontend selection and MeasurementSet preparation
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove duplicate selectors and preparation paths after the Selected Observation transfer.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Moving-source imaging covers cubesource, mvc, TRACKFIELD, named targets, ephemerides, and the public expression surface.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove special moving-source runners and phase adjustments after native tracking transfers.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Primary-beam and product-validity masks remain distinct from CLEAN reconstruction masks.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove the mode-specific writer after mask and product ownership transfers.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: The parent performance contract retains both frozen manifests, the full array contract, the 32 GiB ceiling, every supported surface, and four end-to-end rows each achieving at least 10x speedup.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: No VLASS-specific alternative owner or reduced performance contract may remain.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Evidence retains two manifest identities, archive SHA b80d5e9830ce3835837175ccd786de581bf39312a402b7acf89ac0cbf5df353a, CASA 6.7.5.9 fiducials, cold/warm roles, and complete product inventories.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove duplicate comparator or manifest ownership; keep one canonical evidence path.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Bounded input covers 16 spectral windows, 10,400 and 655,200 selected rows, multi-DDID streaming, POINTING, and deterministic Briggs weighting.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove the old full or duplicate preparation path.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Serial correctness uses real EVLA A+W projection and pointing MT-MFS, exact product topology, deterministic CLEAN, and no more than 32 GiB.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove W-only aliases and the legacy serial route after transfer.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Acceleration preserves a serial baseline, reports a complete resource ledger, avoids a full grid per worker, selects safe automatic policy, and reaches at least 10x median speedup in all four rows.
issue_outcomes.current_owner: fragmented legacy CPU and Metal planners
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove environment ladders and losing execution paths after the accepted alternatives transfer.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Task/provider, CLI, TUI, macOS, Python, profiles, and assistant surfaces all project canonical semantics with no hidden environment or UI science behavior.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove local defaults and private surface semantics.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Convolution-function artifacts have exact identity, paired cells, bounded generation, atomic caching, corruption and mismatch rejection, CASA cache interoperability, and EVLA/VLASS evidence.
issue_outcomes.current_owner: legacy cache consumer and future native generator
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove runtime preparation while retaining the explicit interoperable importer.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Cube routing preserves bounded selection, descending spectral axes, blank and unmapped cases, and CPU/Metal parity without a MeasurementSet fallback.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove the old cube route after the closed native matrix passes.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Cube products are reopenable and preserve bad-channel beams, common-beam policy, and residual scaling.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove the old writer and beam side path after Product Graph ownership transfers.

issue_outcomes.required_outcome: Multifield W-projection cubes share phase and source routing, spectral and W planning, bounded replay, and explicit unsupported-combination failures.
issue_outcomes.deletion_or_retention_condition: Remove the old multifield W-cube route after all closed cases transfer.
